messages.subject: New release: simmer 4.4.3
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

A new release is on CRAN with several bugfixes and minor features
discussed here (e.g., now the batch activity supports dynamic sizes by
providing a function). See the complete NEWS in [1]. Binaries for
Windows and macOS will appear on CRAN in due course. Binaries for
Fedora Linux will be available tomorrow in Copr [2].

[1] https://r-simmer.org/news/index.html#simmer-4-4-3-2021-08-11
[2] https://copr.fedorainfracloud.org/coprs/iucar/cran/

--
Iñaki Úcar
